TextBlock.Text: Admiral of the Fleet S.G. Gorshkov, Commander-in-Chief of the Soviet Navy (GK VMF)
Commander, Red Banner Northern Fleet; Chief of the Naval General Staff
Combat Employment of Northern Fleet Surface Strike Group — IMMEDIATE ACTION

StackPanel.TextBlock:
1. In accordance with Directive of the Supreme High Command dated 5 June 1985 and the deteriorating situation in the Euro-Atlantic theatre, Red Banner Northern Fleet is ordered to transition to combat operations with immediate effect.
2. , built around the task force flagship, is hereby constituted as an independent raiding and strike group. The task force is assigned the following primary missions:
а. Denial of the Greenland-Iceland-UK Gap to NATO reinforcement shipping and ASW forces.
б. Interdiction and destruction of NATO supply convoys operating in the North Atlantic.
в. Suppression of NATO air and naval power in the Norwegian Sea operational zone.
3. will depart Severomorsk no later than 0600 local time, 5 June 1985. Strict radio silence is to be maintained during the initial transit phase. Submarine screening elements are to precede the surface group by no less than thirty nautical miles.
4. Commanding Officer is authorised to engage any NATO or hostile force encountered in the assigned operational area without further reference to this command. Rules of engagement: WEAPONS FREE against all identified hostile military targets.
5. Resupply and repair facilities will be arranged at designated points along the operational timeline. Further instructions will follow by encrypted burst transmission.
6. The Motherland places full confidence in you, Komanduyushchiy. The eyes of the Fleet are upon . Accomplish your mission.

END OF DIRECTIVE
/s/ GORSHKOV · Admiral Flota Sovetskogo Soyuza
